# Do Right Electrical

## About
Do Right Electrical provides reliable, professional electrical services throughout the Cairns region. Our qualified electricians handle everything from small residential jobs to larger commercial and industrial projects, always with a focus on safety, punctuality and honest communication.

## Services
Smoke Alarm Installations
Household Electrical Services
Air Conditioning Repairs & Installations
Switchboard Upgrades & Generator Changeover Switches

## Service Areas
Trinity Beach
Edmonton
Smithfield
Cairns
